content:
Ana Patel: Heads-up — conference has confirmed our podium slot at 2:15pm on Day 2. We also got a virtual demo booth. Need run-of-show for both.
Mike Chen: awesome. what's the audience size?
Ana Patel: expect ~200 in-room, virtual expo traffic ~1-2k peak.
Tara Gomez: priority list: speaker slides + benchmark narrative, swag qty + ship ETA, demo flow for virtual booth, lead routing + follow-up cadence.
Jamal Rivers: for speaker subs — we have 3 internal speakers. Do we need external case study?
Ana Patel: yes, we'll pitch a customer panel. Jamal can you reach out to Ops for approval by Fri?
Jamal Rivers: on it. sending templates to @Tara by EOD.
Evan Li: swag update — hoodies delayed. Alternative: smaller sticker pack + branded notebook. Can ship by next Wed if we confirm qty today.
Tara Gomez: sticker + notebook sounds fine. Order 500 notebooks, 1.2k sticker packs. Budget OK?
Mike Chen: ok from budget. What's lead capture?
Ana Patel: Landing page + QR codes at booth. We'll route leads into Airtable with source tags (podium / virtual / walkup). Webhook -> CRM.
Tara Gomez: suggest immediate preset for webinar follow-up: day0 thank you + survey, day3 case study invite, day10 benchmark deep-dive webinar.
Evan Li: for the benchmark narrative, can we surface these three metrics: median 95th pct latency, cost-per-1k-tokens, and per-request failure rate? Need short stat bullets for slide.
Mike Chen: I can run the numbers. Will post a small chart.
marketing-bot: new speaker submission received: "Optimizing LLM serving at scale" by @Marcus.
Ana Patel: great — @Mike please vet Marcus' deck by Tue.
Tara Gomez: virtual demo flow: 1) welcome message, 2) 3-min baseline demo, 3) latency/cost comparison microdash, 4) sign-up quick form. Keep sessions 10 min.
Jamal Rivers: recommended script for booth staff?
Tara Gomez: short script: "Hi — quick demo? We help reduce token costs by 30% w/ caching + batching. Want a benchmark against your workload?"
Evan Li: can we add a QR that triggers a pre-filled sign-up with company + role? Saves time.
Mike Chen: yes — use ?utm_source=podium&utm_medium=qr&utm_campaign=springconf
Ana Patel: logistics checklist for on-site: power strip (x3), HDMI adapter kit, table signage, shipping manifest, swag bin labels. I'll post packing list shortly.
Tara Gomez: shipping — vendors need address by Tue. @Evan confirm courier pickup on Wed.
Evan Li: booked pickup Wed 10am via CouriersRUs. Tracking to be shared when labels printed.
Jamal Rivers: follow-up owners: day0 -> @Tara, day3 -> @Mike, day10 webinar -> @Ana. Agree?
Tara Gomez: agreed. I'll draft the emails and the webinar registration page.
Ana Patel: launch posts: thread for X / LinkedIn + benchmark highlight card. Draft cadence: pre-event teaser (3 days), live day post, post-event recap with benchmark and CTA.
Mike Chen: I'll hand off the chart + 2-sentence key takeaway for the social card.
marketing-bot: reminder: print order cutoff in 48 hours.
Evan Li: placing print order now for notebooks + stickers. ETA Wed.
Ana Patel: final ask — can everyone add availability for on-site shifts in the Doodle by EOD? Also need headcount for staff training session Fri noon.
Mike Chen: done.
Tara Gomez: added.
Jamal Rivers: added.
Evan Li: added.
Ana Patel: perfect. I'll update the runbook and post link here when ready. :tada:
